description.en: The Master of Science in Mathematical Sciences is a research programme that empowers students with a competitive edge in research through in-depth training mediated by experts. As a postgraduate student, candidates will be integrated as members of our research groups at Sunway University with various opportunities to participate in research alongside supervisors through seminars, workshops, laboratory and field work. The programme will focus on research areas such as evolutionary computation, big data analytics, computational fluid dynamics, statistical process control, and more. This programme will develop the following graduate attributes which are in sync with and support the mission of the university: highly employable graduates who are knowledgeable and technically competent in various fields of mathematics and statistics. graduates with the mathematical and analytical skills with competencies in critical thinking and problem solving. graduates with managerial and entrepreneurial skills to be able to communicate effectively. graduates who are ethical and responsible with expertise in mathematical and statistical knowledge. graduates who recognize the need to engage in life-long learning for personal and professional growth and development. Graduates of this programme will be equipped with a versatile range of skills that lend themselves to multiple industries. This allows graduates to pursue senior positions in fields such as finance, education, consultancy, administration, IT, business, and more.

description.en: The Master in Medical Science is a research-based programme for students who have graduated from a bachelor’s degree in medical science or a related field and wish to develop research capabilities in the field. It aims to nurture students with holistic approaches and includes opportunities for national or international collaborations, specialised training activities (seminars, workshops, etc), and a rich clinical research experience. Medical science studies the biological mechanisms underlying the function of human body, with the emphasis on diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases. Research coverage of medical science is very broad and it ranges from basic biology to oncology; chemistry to pharmacology; and physics to radiotherapy. In line with the departmental mission and vision, we undertake research in 4 key focus areas: DISEASES To improve the knowledge of diseases and understand the underlying causes, the molecular pathways and the genes involved in disease. This fundamental knowledge of disease can then be used to develop diagnostic methods. THERAPY & CURES To explore the use of modern technologies or natural resources to address diseases and any other medical challenges. This includes “proof of concept” studies or prototyping approaches. EPIDEMIOLOGY To determine the pattern of distribution and effects of disease in the community so that the future occurrence of disease can be prevented. Observational studies can be used to study distributions and analytical studies are used to study the effects of disease. SUSTAINABLE WELL-BEING To promote human health and, subsequently, life satisfaction for all at all ages. We measure, analyse and manage well-being in response to uncertainty and with respect to ageing, nutrition, climate change, and physical, mental and social health. The Master in Medical Science is offered in partnership with Lancaster University, UK. On successful completion of the programme, the graduates will be awarded two certificates, making them graduates of both Lancaster University and Sunway University. Image

description.en: The Master in Nursing (by Research) programme at Sunway University is a research-intensive postgraduate programme designed to develop competent nurse researchers who contribute to the advancement of nursing knowledge and evidence-based practice. The programme emphasises rigorous scholarly inquiry and is designed for nurses seeking to address complex healthcare challenges through systematic and ethical research. The programme is distinguished by its strong focus on contemporary issues in nursing, healthcare delivery, education, and health systems. Students are encouraged to engage critically with real-world problems that influence patient care, professional practice, service delivery, and health outcomes. Through structured and independent research, students generate evidence that informs practice improvement, innovation, and policy development across diverse healthcare contexts. Under the close supervision of experienced academic staff, students undertake an independent research project within the discipline of nursing. Research may employ appropriate qualitative, quantitative, or mixed-methods designs, depending on the research question and feasibility of the study. Students are guided to select methodologies that are methodologically rigorous, ethically sound, and achievable within the scope and duration of a Master’s degree. Emphasis is placed on critical analysis, interpretation of findings, and adherence to ethical and scholarly standards throughout the research process. To support research competency, students complete a research methodology module that strengthens skills in research design, data management, data analysis, and ethical research conduct. This integrated approach ensures strong methodological preparation alongside thesis development. To fulfil the requirements for graduation, students must submit a dissertation based on original research and successfully pass the thesis examination. The programme also provides a clear progression pathway to doctoral studies, preparing graduates for advanced research, academic, leadership, and policy-oriented roles within the healthcare sector.

description.en: The Master of Philosophy (MPhil) programme in Business Administration is a full research degree that aims to expand a student's research knowledge and capability to conduct independent research in different areas of Business. In addition, students are encouraged to develop new ideas or employ well-thought-out methodologies to produce research that has substantial theoretical and practical contributions. Students will utilise the best-suited research design to explore and/or test informed ideas. The outcome of the research extends the frontiers of knowledge, and students will disseminate the scholarly findings to peers and practitioners, through academic and professional networks, conferences/seminars, and even publications. Sunway University has a dedicated team of academicians to mentor students along their research journey, as they investigate a topic of their choice. Students may pursue a topic or an issue which they are currently researching within a work area, in which case the MPhil can also be of direct relevance to current employment. Alternatively, students can choose to undertake research in any particular area they are passionate about. Although students are allowed to choose any research topic of their interest, the research topic must be contemporary, interesting, and timely.

description.en: This Master’s degree is accredited by the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA). Upon completion of the programme, graduates are eligible for exemptions from CP1, CP2, and CP3 papers, providing a streamlined pathway from their undergraduate studies and a fast track toward qualifying as an Associate of the IFoA. In addition, students will gain analytical skills and exposure to AI-related techniques, ensuring they remain relevant, practical, and capable of delivering value to the organisations they serve. Our programme offers a fast-track route for actuarial students aiming to qualify as an actuary, with three additional CP exemptions from the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA). This provides a seamless continuation from undergraduate studies and accelerates the journey toward professional qualification. Courses are taught by experienced actuaries and academics, ensuring that students gain not only exemption-relevant knowledge but also practical insights and industry-relevant skills. Beyond the core actuarial curriculum, the programme includes advanced analytics and AI-related techniques, equipping students to stay relevant and add value in a rapidly evolving professional landscape. Sunway University’s Actuarial Science programme has been recognised as “Best in Class in Actuarial Science” and “Champion in Actuarial Science” by Talentbank since 2024. We remain committed to delivering high-quality actuarial education and preparing our students for successful careers. Accredited by Image

description.en: The Master in Advanced Computing programme provides advanced training and knowledge in key areas of computing. It offers a profound and in-depth education across software engineering, computer science, and cybersecurity, guiding students to design a learning pathway that aligns with their personal interests and future career opportunities. Students have the flexibility to choose from various track electives, gaining exposure to specialised domains of computing. The programme also supports Malaysia’s national digital transformation agenda, helping to build capabilities for the country as a regional hub for digital innovation and smart technology. Graduates of this programme will be equipped to: Design advanced computing solutions by applying concepts, principles, and methodologies, supported by both quantitative and qualitative information, to solve real-world and scientific problems. Utilise the latest digital tools and technologies to develop innovative, advanced computing solutions. Communicate and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders in managing business ventures and projects. Contribute continuously to industry and society, upholding ethical conduct, professional practices, and integrity. Image

description.en: This programme aims to transform graduates into Malaysia Certified Behaviour Analysts after achieving the minimal supervised practice hours satisfying the training guidelines of the Malaysia Association of Behaviour Analysis. Sunway University is proud to be the first and only provider of the Master of Applied Behaviour Analysis programme in the Southeast Asia region. The curriculum of the programme covers a range of theoretical and practical aspects of applied behaviour analysis. Graduates will learn to analyse and modify behaviour using principles of applied behaviour analysis in any industry or circumstance that requires behavioural change or maintenance. They will understand these principles deeply and learn how to implement them effectively in various contexts, allowing them to address behavioural issues and promote positive behaviour change. Graduates will also contribute predominantly to the behavioural assessments and interventions involving individuals with developmental disabilities such as autism. This could include designing and implementing behaviour intervention plans, conducting assessments to identify specific behavioural challenges, and collaborating with other professionals to provide comprehensive support. description.en: Sunway University’s Master of Science in Applied Mathematics is an interdisciplinary field that focuses on the application of mathematics, statistics, and computational methods to intelligently model and describe the behaviour of real world’s complex systems. These skills are useful in various career prospectus such as: AI Development Analyst Computational Analyst Computer Programmers Data Encryption Coding Analyst Digital Modelling Scientist Economic Analyst Environmental Scientist Financial Analyst Medical Modelling Scientist Operations Research Analyst Policy Modelling Scientist Predictive Modelling Scientist Risk Management Consultant Statistical Analyst Supply Chain Analyst This taught master degree aims to equip students with the latest knowledge in optimization, optimal control, machine learning, mathematical modelling, simulation and mathematical and statistical techniques. All of these serve as important tools in solving sophisticated problems constantly faced by businesses, industries, companies and governments. Modules in this programme include: Computational and Numerical Methods Control and Systems Theory Discrete and Combinatorial Optimization Mathematical Modelling Network Design and Analysis Operations Research Optimal Control Statistics and Applied Probability Unconstrained and Constrained Optimization By embracing new mathematical methods and techniques, students who complete this programme shall develop and gain a skillset which opens up abundant opportunities for a fulfilling and lucrative career as an applied mathematician in the many industries mentioned above. Uniqueness of the Programme Mathematics is an important language for invention, innovation and idea creation. Applied mathematicians play a crucial role in many on-going dedicated efforts by individuals, organisations, businesses, and governments in tackling issues that affect the livelihood of large portions of humanity, in mitigating potential future threats to planetary health, and in protecting our earth to ensure our species’ continued existence. Sunway University’s MSc in Applied Mathematics programme equips its graduates with an innovative mindset to apply mathematical tools and knowledge to provide practical solutions to a wide spectrum of problems arising from the physical and medical sciences, engineering, technology, finance and investment, business, commerce and social sciences. The School of Mathematical Sciences (SMS) has experienced Professors, Associate Professors, and Senior Lecturers to deliver all the modules, and a supportive team to assist students in their study. This includes having a professor who is a World Top 2% Scientist, with a strong network with researchers from various parts of the world, particularly ASEAN and China. This professor has an excellent track record in optimization and optimal control, leading the team in the teaching and delivery of the modules. As a result, graduates from our MSc in Applied Mathematics will have a competitive advantage over those completing similar programmes from many other universities. SMS has a variety of activities such as seminars, research talk series, trainings and more to equip students with soft skills and up-to-date information.

description.en: The Master in Artificial Intelligence at Sunway University offers a distinctive learning experience driven by state-of-the-art facilities, impactful research, and a vibrant academic community. Students benefit from a dedicated AI and Machine Learning Lab equipped with high-performance GPU-powered systems, NVIDIA Jetson Nano, and IoT prototyping kits to support hands-on learning in real-world applications. Uniquely, the programme also offers access to NVIDIA GPU-accelerated computing on AWS for scalable AI model development, giving students access to industry-relevant tools and infrastructure. The programme offers several courses in artificial intelligence that align with Malaysia’s national digital transformation agenda, enabling the nation to strengthen its capabilities as a regional hub for digital innovation and smart technology. Sunway University’s Master in Artificial Intelligence develops graduates to be AI specialists with: Advanced knowledge, enhanced technical skills, and strong numeracy abilities to employ relevant quantitative information for developing innovative AI-based solutions to solve real-world and scientific problems. The capability to use various digital tools and techniques for innovative AI-based solutions. Effective communication and collaborative skills with stakeholders in managing business ventures and projects. The ability to contribute to industry and society through professional skills and ethics, applying AI-based solutions while engaging in lifelong learning and continuous professional development. description.en: Tailored for aspiring managers who have the ambition to become strategic leaders in an increasingly complex organisational and business environment, this programme guides you in exploring the leader within. Learn from our academics and C-suite industry leaders, gaining both scholastic knowledge and real-world insights, and emerge as a change agent in the business world and beyond. Balance work and study with ease with one course in each 8-week short semester and two courses in each 16-week long semester. Our fully face-to-face physical classes give you the fullest advantage for networking opportunities and engagements with C-suite leaders, our faculty, and coursemates who are industry professionals from various industries, leading to lifelong friendships, mentorships, and career opportunities. Image Earn 2 world-class MBAs 1 from Sunway University (accredited by AACSB and prestigious global bodies) and 1 from Lancaster University (triple crown accredited with AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA – the most influential business school accreditation bodies. Students from this programme will be able to access Harvard Business Publishing Education resources for real-world insights, and study at Malaysia’s first non-government linked private university accredited by AACSB, the global gold standard held by less than 6% of business schools worldwide. Sunway Business School is also a member of the Principles for Responsible Management Education (PRIME), the European Foundation for Management Development (EFMD), and the Business Graduates Association. Image Image Our C-suite series connects you with top industry leaders, enriching your professional perspectives and leadership growth.

description.en: Master of Business Analytics is a comprehensive, industry-relevant programme designed to incorporate three essential domains; business analytics, information technology and business innovation. This programme provides the necessary intellectual underpinning theories and practice in business analytics and business-related areas to enable holistic learning. The curriculum has been carefully designed to identify and understand problems in a wide range of business domains and apply data-driven, analytical approaches to describe and diagnose business problems, predict future possibilities, and prescribe solutions. Master of Business Analytics will provide students with the skills and knowledge necessary to set a Business Analytics career in motion. The programme provides specialist knowledge to become competent in predictive analytics, explore new tools available in the industry and hone your skills in the science of decision making.

description.en: The Master of Arts in Communication is designed to empower individuals who aspire to thrive in today’s rapidly evolving media and information landscape. As communication continues to shape how businesses, governments, and societies interact, there is an increasing demand for professionals who can navigate complex issues, bridge diverse audiences, and deliver impactful messages across multiple platforms. This programme responds directly to that demand by equipping you with the advanced knowledge, practical skills, and strategic mindset needed to become a leader in the field. At its core, the programme merges academic rigour with industry relevance. You will explore diverse areas of communication, from interpersonal and intercultural exchanges to mass media, digital culture, crisis management, and brand storytelling. Each course is carefully crafted to provide both theoretical depth and hands-on application, ensuring that you can connect classroom learning to real-world challenges. Through interactive classes, case studies, applied research, and industry-linked projects, you will sharpen your ability to design strategies, analyse audiences, and craft compelling narratives that inspire action. By emphasising sustainability, ethics, and leadership, the programme prepares graduates not just to succeed but to make a meaningful impact in shaping communication for the future. The programme explores a broad spectrum of communication areas to build a solid foundation and specialised expertise: Interpersonal and intercultural communication Mass media and digital culture Strategic communication and public relations Research methods in communication Sustainability and ethical branding in communication practice Through live case studies, industry-linked projects, and applied research, you’ll gain practical insight while deepening theoretical knowledge.

description.en: The Master of Counselling programme at Sunway University is designed to develop highly competent and reflective counselling professionals equipped to work in a variety of settings, including educational institutions, community agencies, and workplace environments. Graduates of this programme will be well-prepared to pursue professional certification as registered counsellors with the Board of Counsellors (Malaysia) – Lembaga Kaunselor Malaysia (LKM). Through structured coursework and supervised practical experiences, students will gain the theoretical foundation and hands-on skills essential for effective counselling practice. This 48-credit programme offers a focused and flexible pathway for individuals seeking to positively impact mental health and well-being. Delivered by an experienced team of counselling academics and practitioners, the curriculum integrates core domains such as lifespan development, counselling theories, ethics, multicultural understanding, assessment techniques, and group counselling. Emphasis is placed on evidence-based practices, scientific thinking, and ethical responsibility, enabling graduates to apply professional counselling knowledge in diverse real-world settings. In addition to strong academic training, the programme cultivates key professional competencies such as effective communication with clients and stakeholders, critical and creative problem-solving, ethical decision-making, and cultural sensitivity. Students will develop the ability to use digital tools in counselling practice, interpret psychological data confidently, and lead mental health initiatives in organisational and community contexts. The programme also encourages a commitment to lifelong learning, professional development, and entrepreneurial thinking in counselling practice. As part of Sunway University’s Faculty of Medical and Life Sciences, the Master of Counselling benefits from a collaborative ecosystem of healthcare, education, and innovation. Supported by the broader Sunway Education Group’s commitment to excellence, students can access vibrant academic and practical resources that enhance their journey toward becoming competent and compassionate counsellors. Apply now to begin your journey with a programme that combines rigorous academic training, ethical grounding, and a humanistic approach to counselling. Approved and adhering to the standards of the Board of Counsellors, Malaysia (Lembaga Kaunselor Malaysia) What are the Differences between an Internship and a Practicum? Aspect Internship Practicum Purpose Provides substantial, real-world exposure to the field; integrates students into the professional environment. Focuses on applying academic learning in a controlled environment; emphasises skill development. Duration Typically lasts several months, with full-time or part-time hours. Generally shorter in duration, integrated into a specific course or academic term. Structure Comprehensive experience with a range of tasks and responsibilities. Structured schedule with a focus on the direct application of counselling skills. Responsibilities Broader scope, including case management, client interaction, and administrative tasks. Specific tasks related to developing and refining counselling skills. Supervision Regular supervision with opportunities for independent work; overall performance evaluation. Intensive supervision with detailed feedback on skill application and adherence to ethics. Scope Involves a range of responsibilities and integration into the professional setting. Emphasises specific skill development and practical application within a guided framework. How should I prepare for the Board of Counsellors (Malaysia) – Lembaga Kaunselor Malaysia? Upon completing the internship and practicum, you may apply for your registered and practising licensure with the Board while waiting for the official graduation scroll (subject to LKM’s processes and approval). Refer to the infographic below for more information. Image Click here to prepare for the interview! Programme Difference at A Glance Image

description.en: The Masters of Counselling (Clinical Mental Health) programme at Sunway University is designed to cultivate highly knowledgeable and skilled counselling professionals ready to address mental health issues within the community. Graduates will be prepared to pursue professional certification as registered counsellors with the Board of Counsellors (Malaysia) – Lembaga Kaunselor Malaysia. By completing the required supervised practice hours and meeting the Board's requirements, they will gain both theoretical knowledge and practical skills essential for effective counselling. As the first private institution in Southeast Asia to offer this programme, Sunway University provides a comprehensive curriculum that covers a wide range of behavioural assessment and intervention techniques. The programme includes core areas such as developmental psychology, counselling theories, multicultural competence, career development, and group counselling. It emphasizes the application of scientific, statistical, and digital methods while upholding a strong focus on ethical practices. Additionally, students can choose from electives like marital and family counselling, tele-mental health, and counselling entrepreneurship, which further enrich their learning experience. Upon graduation, students will possess key attributes to excel in the counselling profession. They will have a deep understanding of fundamental counselling principles and the ability to apply critical and creative thinking to solve mental health issues using scientific approaches. Graduates will adeptly manage mental health challenges with advanced research methods and practical counselling skills, demonstrating effective community interaction and support. They will excel in clear communication with both experts and laypersons and will be proficient in leveraging digital tools in their practice. Furthermore, they will possess strong numeracy skills for data interpretation, show leadership in addressing community mental health needs, and commit to lifelong learning and professional development. Our graduates will also bring entrepreneurial skills to advance the field of counselling and adhere to the highest ethical standards in their professional conduct. The Masters of Counselling (Clinical Mental Health) programme at Sunway University stands out due to its unique association with the Sunway Group and its strong linkage to Sunway Medical Centre. As part of the prestigious Sunway Group, which is renowned for its excellence in education, healthcare, and integrated facilities, our programme benefits from an extensive network and a commitment to holistic, high-quality education. The partnership with Sunway Medical Centre provides students with valuable opportunities for internships, practical training, and collaborative research projects, ensuring that graduates are well-prepared for real-world challenges in the mental health field. Apply now to be part of a programme that blends academic excellence with practical, industry-leading resources. Approved and adhering to the standard of the Board of Counsellors, Malaysia (Lembaga Kaunselor Malaysia) What are the Differences between Internship and Practicum? Aspect Internship Practicum Purpose Provides substantial, real-world exposure to the field; integrates students into the professional environment. Focuses on applying academic learning in a controlled environment; emphasises skill development. Duration Typically lasts several months, with full-time or part-time hours. Generally shorter in duration, integrated into a specific course or academic term. Structure Comprehensive experience with a range of tasks and responsibilities. Structured schedule with a focus on the direct application of counselling skills. Responsibilities Broader scope, including case management, client interaction, and administrative tasks. Specific tasks related to developing and refining counselling skills. Supervision Regular supervision with opportunities for independent work; overall performance evaluation. Intensive supervision with detailed feedback on skill application and adherence to ethics. Scope Involves a range of responsibilities and integration into the professional setting. Emphasises specific skill development and practical application within a guided framework. How should I prepare for the Board of Counsellors (Malaysia) – Lembaga Kaunselor Malaysia? Upon completing the internship and practicum, you may apply for your registered and practising licensure with the Board while waiting for the official graduation scroll (subject to LKM’s processes and approval). Refer to the infographic here for more information.

description.en: The Master in Digital Engineering programme at Sunway University (MQF Level 7) is designed to address the growing demand for advanced digital knowledge and skills among engineering graduates. It offers courses which can effectively upskill current and future engineers to suit the rapidly evolving digital landscape in engineering-related industries. This programme complements the existing conventional engineering undergraduate programmes by focusing on advanced computation and simulation, artificial intelligence and other advanced digital technologies which can be readily deployed in engineering-related industries. The programme is delivered through flexible modes to support working professionals. Aligned with national priorities such as the Malaysia Education Blueprint, Industrial Revolution 4.0, and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the Master in Digital Engineering prepares graduates to translate research into practice, drive innovation, and lead transformative change in engineering and technology. The Uniqueness of the Programme at Sunway The Master in Digital Engineering at Sunway University offers a distinctive blend of advanced coursework and applied research designed to meet the evolving needs of industry. It bridges academic insight with real-world practice, enabling candidates to develop innovative solutions that directly address challenges within their own professional environments. Supporting the applied research focus, the coursework provides a strong foundation in entrepreneurship, sustainability, and strategic management, preparing candidates to lead innovation and implement responsible engineering practices. This is complemented by a suite of engineering electives covering emerging areas such as artificial intelligence, digital twins, smart systems, advanced materials, and robotics, ensuring relevance to the demands of Industry 4.0 and future technologies. Within Sunway University’s state-of-the-art facilities and research-driven ecosystem, candidates are guided by experienced supervisors and researchers who combine academic rigour with an industrial perspective. The programme’s flexible hybrid delivery allows working professionals to balance career progression with academic advancement, supporting lifelong learning and leadership growth. Together, these features make the Master in Digital Engineering at Sunway University a transformative pathway for professionals seeking to lead innovation and drive sustainable technological advancement within their industries.

description.en: The Master of Education is a taught programme at Sunway University designed to deliver a comprehensive and engaging learning experience through its immersive and face-to-face coursework mode. Designed to meet the diverse needs of education professionals, the programme replaces examinations with project-based assessments, emphasising the practical application of knowledge and skills. Image Offered in both full-time and part-time modes, the programme provides flexibility for students to align their studies with their personal and professional commitments. There are six learning blocks per year. For full-time students, each block consists of two courses and a research project, while for part-time students, each block consists of one course and a research project. It features three specialisations: Instructional Technology , Educational Management , and Early Childhood Education . These specialisations empower teachers, school leaders and early childhood educators with advanced expertise to address the evolving challenges in the education field. A recently introduced course on Artificial Intelligence in Education underscores Sunway University’s dedication to integrating cutting-edge technological advancements into pedagogy. Students benefit from the guidance of experienced instructors who bring extensive academic and practical expertise to foster a dynamic and enriching learning environment. The programme is suited for educators aiming to elevate their professional competencies, adopt innovative teaching strategies and expand their leadership potential. Whether the goal is to refine classroom practices or transition into leadership roles, this programme equips students with the knowledge, tools and professional network needed to thrive in the ever-evolving education landscape. On successful completion of the programme, graduates will also be awarded a degree from Lancaster University. They will be awarded two certificates, making them graduates of both Sunway University and Lancaster University. Image Why Choose Our Programme? A Synergy of Theory and Practice This programme seamlessly integrates foundational theories with real-world applications. Core modules such as Measurement, Assessment and Evaluation and Educational Research Methodology equip students with essential tools for conducting impactful educational studies and evaluating student outcomes effectively. Additionally, applied modules such as Learning Cognition and AI in Education prepare students to address contemporary challenges in diverse educational contexts to fostering innovative and reflective practices. The programme is designed to cultivate educators and professionals who are well-versed in both theoretical frameworks and pragmatic solutions for advancing education. Specialisations Tailored to Your Career Path Personalise your learning with three distinctive specialisations: Instructional Technology : Ideal for educators keen on harnessing digital tools to create interactive and engaging learning experiences. This pathway equips you with cutting-edge knowledge in educational technology. Educational Management : Perfect for aspiring school or institutional leaders. This pathway develops strategic thinking, organisational management and innovative leadership skills. Early Childhood Education : Designed for professionals passionate about nurturing young learners. This specialisation focuses on designing impactful early childhood programmes grounded in developmental research. Focus on Emerging Educational Innovations The programme incorporates emerging trends in education, with key modules such as AI in Education . It empowers students to adopt and lead innovations in education, keeping pace with the technological advancements shaping modern classrooms. Comprehensive Research Opportunities The programme offers a structured research component: Courseworks : Provides an opportunity to bridge theoretical knowledge with practical applications, enabling students to address real-world educational challenges effectively. Research Projects 1 & 2 : Facilitates an in-depth investigation, culminating in a meaningful and original contribution to the field of education. This emphasis on coursework and research projects ensures that graduates leave with the ability to critically analyse, innovate, and contribute meaningful insights to their field. Versatility Across Educational Contexts Whether in primary, second or higher education, as well as corporate training, the curriculum equips students with skills applicable across a range of settings. Modules such as Global Issues in Educational Technology make graduates adaptable to both local and international education systems. Dynamic and Credit-Rich Curriculum The curriculum balances compulsory modules with specialisations to offer depth and flexibility. This ensures a comprehensive educational experience tailored to individual interests and professional aspirations. What Makes Us Unique? Future-Focused Curriculum: With modules addressing AI integration, digital transformation, and leadership in education, the programme prepares graduates to meet emerging challenges with confidence. Specialisations Aligned with Professional Goals: Instructional Technology , Educational Management , and Early Childhood Education pathways provide targeted expertise in key areas. description.en: The Master of Human Resource Management (MHRM) programme is designed in collaboration with the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD), the world’s largest Chartered HR and development body, for aspiring managers and professionals with the ambition to become strategic leaders and human resource managers. Students will be acquiring expertise not only through knowledge of contemporary human resource management theories, concepts and tools but will also be working in a team throughout the programme and building sets of skills they can apply in practice. Since today’s organisations operate in a dynamic and complex environment with varying structures and cultures, the MHRM programme will equip students with the knowledge and leadership skills needed to face human resource challenges and meet the strategic needs of business. Upon completion of the programme, graduates are awarded with dual certificates: MHRM certificate from Sunway University and a postgraduate-level Advanced Diploma in Human Resource Management from the CIPD. Graduates also upgrade their status to Associate Membership of CIPD and use the designatory letters ‘Assoc CIPD’ after their name that demonstrates that they have attained a recognised level of professional competence as an HR practitioner. Validation Image

description.en: The Master in International Hospitality Management postgraduate programme is designed for current and aspiring leaders aiming to enhance their expertise and take on strategic roles within the global hospitality industry. It develops strategic, analytical, and innovation-driven competencies through advanced modules such as Revenue Management, Brand Management, and Marketing Innovation. Students are also complemented by robust training in Research Methods and an applied Hospitality Research Project. The curriculum is tailored to equip graduates for leadership roles across service sectors, including but not limited to international event planning, destination development, and market intelligence. Career opportunities include Regional General Manager, Executive Business Development Manager, Hospitality Consultant, or Product Development Specialist. The programme also prepares candidates for doctoral study or entrepreneurship in the hospitality and tourism industry.

description.en: The Master of Marketing programme will take you on a developmental journey of skills and knowledge needed to become an effective and reflective marketing practitioner. You will gain in-depth understanding of markets and how they work, and be introduced to the theories, tools and techniques that firms use to connect with and shape markets. This programme will constantly challenge you as you put theory into practice and learn how to uncover new and emerging consumer practices that have the potential to create new markets. This programme will critically explore global issues facing firms, markets and consumers, providing you with the ultimate springboard to a range of marketing-related careers. On successful completion of the programme, the graduates will also be awarded with a degree from Lancaster University. They will be awarded two certificates, making them graduates of both Sunway University and Lancaster University. Image

description.en: The Master in Sustainable Development Management (MSDM) at the Jeffrey Sachs Center aims to create a new generation of multidisciplinary practitioners adept at management and problem-solving using analytics and systems thinking guided by global concerns. The programme aims to equip students with necessary management skills and acumen to create innovative solutions to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It encompasses corporate sustainability strategies, social entrepreneurship, finance and sustainability, sustainable management and operations, as well as economics and development. This is built upon a broad knowledge base that covered critical areas like climate change, waste management, energy systems, agriculture and food systems, forestry, and biodiversity. Students are not only exposed to theories and concepts but also real-world practices and case studies to gain a holistic understanding of the opportunities and challenges to achieving the SDGs in scientific, economic, business, and technological aspects.

description.en: Communications and Media are an ever growing and changing part of the world we live in. Be it Netflix, Facebook, Instagram, your favourite online game, or an interactive installation you just saw in a museum, media messaging is a part of your life. Today, these messages are formulated around narratives. In all forms of media, we see the shaping of messages through the narratives of branding. We will investigate these concepts of media through this framework of narratives. We will look at how contemporary media has developed narratives as an organising principle and what that means for society. In this programme, you will learn how messages are formed and how they affect our society and culture. You will be able to analyse how various media determine and define how messages are transmitted. You will understand how new technologies affect the messaging we receive. You will learn this through a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical experience. Finally, you will develop a research-based thesis project. This is an approach to research that combines creative and academic research practices. It supports the development of knowledge and innovation through artistic expression, scholarly investigation, and experimentation. The research-creation process results in an original artistic work with a scholarly component.

description.en: Plan your future Your MBA. Your way. Sunway University’s online Master of Business Administration is designed to offer a balance between core business understanding and future-proof leadership skills. Study just 1 subject at a time in 7-week blocks for optimum learning outcomes while maintaining a healthy work-life-study balance. Course offerings are subject to change based on University scheduling and availability. Prerequisite pathway Students with a non-related bachelor’s degree (minimum CGPA of 2.50) and without the relevant work experience have the opportunity to enrol in the online Master of Finance upon the completion of the Fundamental Business Studies ​prerequisite subject, which can be completed within 7 weeks.
